entries.title: Jeremiah 45:1
segments:
CHAP. XLV. 
 
  Jeremiah instructs and comforts Baruch, ver. 1-5.

entries.title: Jeremiah 45:3
segments: V. 3. I find no rest-Upon Baruch's reading the prophecies both he and Jeremiah were advised to hide themselves.  This probably disturbed Baruch, and made him lament his condition.

entries.title: Jeremiah 45:5
segments: V. 5. Seek them not-Dost thou expect what none is like to meet with who feareth God?  Upon all flesh-I am bringing calamities upon the whole nation.
